dialogues.speaker: Taye
dialogues.text: Dear customer, I'm afraid you're not yet of age to purchase alcohol.

dialogues.speaker: Q'ellu
dialogues.text: D—Don't look at me like I'm just a kid... You lit—little slime-face... I—I'm twenty years old, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Taye
dialogues.text: ...Okay, kiddo, who taught you to talk like that? It's not too late to say sorry, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Q'ellu
dialogues.text: ...Ah, I—I'm sorry. I heard from someone named "Hayne" that "talking rough" was something grown-ups did... I thought I would seem like an adult if I picked that up...

dialogues.speaker: Taye
dialogues.text: Well, that adult was an idiot. Don't you go listening to people like that. Growing up is a natural process, all you have to do is wait for it and make sure you enjoy the ride.

dialogues.speaker: Taye
dialogues.text: And one more thing — if you grow up and start "talking rough" around me, you can forget about me selling you any alcohol. Got that?

dialogues.speaker: Taye
dialogues.text: Because grown-ups can decide what they want to do, and what they don't want to do. Understood?

dialogues.speaker: Q'ellu
dialogues.text: I see... So if I grow up and become a real adult... Could I take you out for a drink, miss?

dialogues.speaker: Taye
dialogues.text: Hah? Pff, give it a rest until you're actually an adult.
